=== simple flow
start
:Read input;
:Process;
stop
=== sdl shape
:Receive order; <<input>>
=== sdl shapes all
:a; <<input>>
:b; <<output>>
:c; <<procedure>>
:d; <<load>>
:e; <<save>>
:f; <<continuous>>
:g; <<task>>
:h; <<object>>
:i; <<objectSignal>>
:j; <<trigger>>
:k; <<sendSignal>>
:l; <<acceptEvent>>
:m; <<timeEvent>>
:n; <<send-signal>>
:o; <<INPUT>>
:p; <<unknown>> <<output>>
=== terminals
start
:a;
end
=== kill and detach
start
:a;
kill
:b;
detach
=== if with else
if (valid?) then (yes)
  :Save;
else (no)
  :Reject;
endif
=== switch
switch (kind)
case (A)
  :Handle A;
case (B)
  :Handle B;
case (C)
  :Handle C;
endswitch
=== while loop
while (more?) is (yes)
  :Read;
endwhile (no)
=== repeat with backward
repeat
  :Read;
  backward :Retry;
repeat while (again?) is (yes) not (no)
=== break in loop
while (more?)
  :Read;
  if (error?) then (yes)
    break
  endif
endwhile
=== fork
fork
  :A;
fork again
  :B;
end fork
=== end merge
fork
  :A;
fork again
  :B;
end merge
=== split
split
  :A;
split again
  :B;
end split
=== two swimlanes
|Customer|
:Order;
|Shop|
:Ship;
=== colored swimlane
|#pink|Customer|
:Order;
|#lightblue|Shop| The Shop
:Ship;
=== partition and group
partition Part1 {
  :A;
}
group Grp {
  :B;
}
package Pkg {
  :C;
}
rectangle Rect {
  :D;
}
card Crd {
  :E;
}
=== labeled arrow
:A;
-> next;
:B;
=== arrow colors and styles
:A;
-[#red,dashed]->
:B;
-[#blue;#green,bold]-> two colors;
:C;
=== connector
:A;
(A)
detach
(A)
:B;
=== notes
:A;
note left: a note
:B;
note right
  multi
  line
end note
floating note: floating
=== rendering without graphviz
start
:A;
stop
